name: popover
title: Popover
description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger. Hosts richer content than Tooltip — a form, a mini-detail card, a filter group, a date pad. Three open behaviors — click (default), hover-with-intent (rare; mostly preview cards), and manual (controlled). Portaled per AGENTS.md hard rule 10. Distinct from Dialog (modal interrupt) and Tooltip (text-only hover hint).
